decision.explanation: The original sources explicitly state that the 1978 college football season included both the '1978 NCAA Division I-A football season' (Document 1) and the '1978 NCAA Division III football season' (Document 3). Document 1 notes that Division I-A was created in 1978 when Division I was subdivided into I-A and I-AA, confirming I-A as a valid division for that year. Document 3 confirms the existence of the Division III season in 1978. While Division I-AA is mentioned as being created alongside I-A, the specific text provided for the season title focuses on I-A and III. No source mentions Divisions II, IV, or higher as having a 1978 season in the provided text. Therefore, the valid answers are the divisions explicitly named as having seasons in 1978 within the source text.
